==Description==
The '''Flash Bang''' is one of the four common [[Consumables|consumables]]. It has a 16.67% (16.22% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Low Grade Crate]] and a 9.23% (7.06% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Mid Grade Crate]].

Only five '''Flashbangs''' can be used in a single match by a single player. It has a 5 second cooldown.

==Usage==
When using the '''Flash Bang''', your avatar's right hand will hold a stun grenade, playing a custom idle animation. You will be able to choose an area where the flash grenade will be thrown. This will make it create a small explosion with a radius of 6.5, applying a five second stun to all enemies caught in it. If an enemy is immune to stuns in any way, the following things will happen based on the immunity:
*If the enemy is [[Stun Immunity|Stun Immune]], it will receive the regular 40% slowdown.
*If the enemy is a [[Boss]], it will receive a unique slowness debuff that slows it down by 50%.

==Appearance==
The '''Flash Bang's''' appearance is a dark green M84 stun grenade, with a glowing yellow interior and a thick cyan line painted on the middle of the exterior. 

==Strategy==
*The '''Flash Bang''' can be helpful for stalling fast enemies such as the [[Error]] or [[Rusher]], giving your towers more time to attack them.
**Do note that several fast enemies have stun immunity, such as the [[Fallen]] or [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]], so the '''Flash Bang''' will be less effective against those.
**Additionally, you should be quick with using the '''Flash Bang''' so you do not accidentally miss.
